blockers: User HOME/.cursor/mcp.json server starts after session/new with mcpServers=[].
allow-always writes a command allowlist that survives a new session and process.
A background shell can remain running after session/prompt returns end_turn.

live-model-isolation.method: Two live ACP processes; B configOptions model observed before/after changing A, and after a tool-free B prompt. No model identity self-report.

session-new-model.method: Extra modelId=gpt-5.4-mini returned currentModelId=composer-2.5; explicit set_model succeeded.

kill-and-load.method: SIGKILL only the owned ACP PID while its prompt and permission were pending; another process session/load and prompt succeeded.

missing-session.method: Missing session/load id returns -32602; missing session/prompt id returns -32603.

failed-turn.method: Shell exit 7 and invalid image both still returned end_turn. An invalid-session RPC error does not prove an initialized backend turn failure.

permission-hold.method: Real shell permission held for 1801 seconds; reject-once response after the hold. See elapsedMs for actual timing.

allow-always.method: Actual allow-always response; one permission first prompt, none in subsequent same-session, new-session and new-process prompts. Isolated cli-config.json permissions contains Shell(python3).

user-mcp-exclusion.method: Distinct stdio server process markers for HOME/.cursor, XDG config and project .cursor paths. Only HOME/.cursor starts after session/new with an empty server list. An explicitly supplied MCP server is a separate positive control.

missing-login.method: Clean environment, isolated HOME and AGENT_CLI_CREDENTIAL_STORE=file; new returns -32000 Authentication required.

expired-login.method: Synthetic expired credentials in isolated file storage are rejected. No genuine expired machine login was available; real auth was not changed.

idle-memory.scope: ps RSS of owned agent acp PID only, excludes children, after completed prompts and a shell failure

tree.scope: owned agent acp PID and descendants after a completed tool-free prompt and three idle seconds
tree.caveat: RSS sums shared pages more than once; not proportional set size

workspace-trust.method: Fresh workspace and isolated config; read marker.txt completed with no client trust method or permission request. This records observed ACP behavior, not a guarantee about other workspace types.

background-shell.method: A 25-second shell exceeded foreground timeout, returned initial stdout and terminal path; final terminal read had end marker and exit_code 0 before prompt returned end_turn.
background-shell.earlyMethod: sleep 12; printf ACP_BG_DONE > background.done, requested 1000ms foreground timeout and immediate response. end_turn at 11418ms; marker absent then and present later.

format.wire: JSONL process, direction=sent|received, elapsedMs, message=full JSON-RPC
format.observations: direction=observation contains process, marker, configuration or RSS observations, never an ACP response
format.timing: elapsedMs is monotonic since the individual capture program started; compare within one process/probe, not across programs

replacements: home and workspace paths, including encoded workspace names
privacy.configuration: Only permission allow/deny and ACP model selection fields retained. No credential file contents captured.

isolation.credentials: Native machine login for normal captures; isolated file store for missing/synthetic-expired cases. Private-home MCP probe links Library/Keychains to machine Keychains so Cursor can use native login; no keychain contents are read by the capture program.
isolation.configuration: MCP and allow-always tests write only private probe folders. Model selection restored through session/set_model. Shared login and user MCP configuration are not changed.

reproduce.output: Set ACP_PROBE_OUTPUT to an empty directory. Each program appends to its trace file.
reproduce.hold: The hold program needs at least 30 minutes; run other captures alongside it.
reproduce.privateFolders: Each program creates its own workspace under node_modules/.cache. These private folders include Cursor-created configuration and session data and must not be committed.
